baseline_models.focus_anchor: The interrogative أَهُمْ خَيْرٌ is bound to the destroyed prior peoples and to the causal clause إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا مُجْرِمِينَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Khayr opens a claim to chosen excellence, qawm supplies collective identity, and priorness, ruin, earning, and offense turn the comparison into a test of whether rank can exempt a group from an incurred fate.

activation_trace.role: Chosen excellence supplies the rank whose alleged possession is being tested.
A human collective makes the comparison corporate rather than merely individual.
Temporal priorness supplies completed comparators against the present group.
Ruin and extinction provide the concrete outcome that tests claimed superiority.
Earning and causing liability supply the causal bridge from conduct to outcome.
Guilt and offense keep the causal bridge morally and legally anchored.

changed_reading.before: The verse compares one people with stronger ancient peoples and warns of destruction.
changed_reading.after: The question tests superiority as a claim to exemption: collective rank does not interrupt the offense-to-ruin relation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: قَوْمُ تُبَّعٍ and وَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِم place the present addressees after already terminated collectives.
baseline_models.mechanism: The group can be heard as occupying another's standing-place; priorness orders the occupants, while destruction and completed time empty the slot. The comparison therefore asks whether the present replacement is structurally different from those it follows.

activation_trace.role: Standing in another's place turns successive peoples into occupants of one historical slot.
Station and residence give the recurring historical slot a spatial footing.
Earlier order arranges former and current occupants in sequence.
Completed and cut-off time marks a people's tenure as terminable.
Extinction empties the occupied slot without proving the successor better.

changed_reading.before: Those before are remote examples brought in for comparison.
changed_reading.after: Those before are prior occupants, and the addressees are the next occupants being tested in the same historical position.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The causal مُجْرِمِينَ immediately follows أَهْلَكْنَٰهُمْ and can activate more than the offense branch of ج ر م.
baseline_models.mechanism: J-r-m joins earning with cutting and harvest residue. The offenders are thus both acquirers of liability and a crop cut off at completion; destruction becomes the material completion of what they acquired.

activation_trace.role: Cutting and harvesting supply the material action latent in the offender label.
Harvest residue supplies the state left after the cutting action.
Earning and incurring connect the material harvest to moral acquisition.
Ruin supplies the terminal state into which the acquired crop is cut.

changed_reading.before: They were destroyed because they bore the legal label criminals.
changed_reading.after: Their criminality is an active acquisition that ripens into their own cutting-off, so the cause and destruction share one process.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening differentiation of matters, the denied but asserted raising, and the appointed gathering for separation place the focus destruction inside a larger cut-and-regather sequence. Historical extinction is a cutoff, not the final disposal of its subjects.

activation_trace.role: Extinction supplies the apparently terminal event whose scope is revised.
Completed and cut-off time recasts ruin as a bounded historical interval.
Discriminating one thing from another supplies an ordered cutting function near the surah's opening.
Reviving the dead supplies the reversal of apparent extinction.
Judgment separating truth from falsehood gives the later gathering its adjudicative purpose.
An appointed time makes the transition from cutoff to gathering scheduled rather than accidental.
Joining what was dispersed reverses historical separation at the appointed judgment.

structural_cues: 44:4 differentiates every matter before the focus narrative begins.
44:35 denies raising, while 44:40 answers with an appointed separation gathering everyone.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies differentiation, temporal cutoff, revival, appointment, and regathering; I order them as destruction followed by reopening for judgment. A live alternative is that the destruction and resurrection motifs are adjacent but not one staged mechanism.

changed_reading.before: أَهْلَكْنَٰهُمْ reports a terminal end that completes the comparison.
changed_reading.after: The destruction cuts a people out of historical standing, but the cut is later reversed by regathering for a final discriminating judgment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The Pharaoh sequence repeats the focus frame of a prior qawm and a criminal qawm, but first names an assay and a messenger encounter. That sequence changes the focus comparison from a static ranking of peoples into a repeated diagnostic whose result is exposed by response to warning.

activation_trace.role: Priorness anchors the focus's historical comparator.
The collective is the unit submitted to comparison and diagnosis.
Offense is the focus's stated diagnostic result.
Assaying metal or people supplies a test that reveals rather than presumes condition.
The same priorness branch establishes an explicit earlier test case.
Pharaoh's people instantiate the same collective unit as the focus comparator.
The repeated offense label records the exposed result of the narrated test.

structural_cues: 44:17 begins an earlier-people episode with testing and messenger arrival.
44:22 repeats qawm plus mujrim before the episode reaches drowning and dispossession.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a test, messenger encounter, repeated collective vocabulary, criminal labeling, and ruin; I infer that the focus question runs the same assay on its addressees. A live alternative is that the repeated labels only classify a fixed type rather than narrate how it becomes visible.

changed_reading.before: Tubba and earlier peoples are a list of powerful precedents.
changed_reading.after: They are prior assay results, and the focus question itself exposes whether the present qawm reproduces the response that earned the criminal designation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The Pharaoh episode leaves cultivated places and an honored station intact, then transfers them to another qawm. Destruction therefore removes holders while preserving a transferable standing, making present possession evidence of succession rather than superiority.

activation_trace.role: Standing in another's place anchors the replacement reading in the focus qawm.
Ruin removes the former holders from their historical station.
Leaving a trace after departure makes the destroyed people's estate persist.
Station and residence identify what remains occupiable after its people are removed.
Inheritance transfers what belonged to predecessors into successor hands.
Another qawm explicitly stands in the removed people's place.

structural_cues: 44:25-27 inventories gardens, springs, crops, station, and ease that outlive their users.
44:28 names another qawm as recipient of what remains.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies abandonment, preserved estate, station, inheritance, and a successor people; I infer that the focus addressees likewise occupy a revocable inherited position. A live alternative is that the transfer only explains Pharaoh's material aftermath and does not govern the Tubba comparison.

changed_reading.before: Destruction proves that an older people and its world simply vanished.
changed_reading.after: Destruction removes occupants but leaves standing and goods transferable, so the present group's possession cannot prove that it is better than prior holders.

context_deltas.mechanism: Abandoned crops and harvest activate j-r-m's cutting and residue branches; after the focus, a tree becomes the offender's food and is tasted. The material sequence lets acquired offense ripen, be harvested, and return to its acquirer as experienced consequence.

activation_trace.role: Cutting and harvesting make mujrim the pivot of the agricultural mechanism.
Dried harvest residue supplies the aftermath of being cut off.
Earning and causing liability direct the crop image back to moral acquisition.
What remains after abandonment supplies a visible residue before the focus.
Crop harvest directly wakes the cutting sense latent in j-r-m.
A stemmed tree supplies the later source from which consequence is consumed.
Fruit reaching edible flavor supplies ripening between tree and consequence.
Experiencing by tasting makes the earned consequence return personally to its acquirer.

structural_cues: 44:25-26 places abandoned gardens and crops before the focus's mujrim label.
44:43-49 moves after the focus from tree to offender's food to commanded tasting.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies crops, harvest, residue, a tree, food, and tasting around j-r-m's cutting and earning branches; I supply the arrow that offense grows into personally consumed consequence. A live alternative is that the agricultural and punishment images belong to separate episodes without a shared material circuit.

changed_reading.before: Criminality is an abstract reason appended to destruction.
changed_reading.after: Criminality is what they cultivate and acquire, while destruction harvests it and the later tasting makes them consume its matured result.

context_deltas.mechanism: The nearby choice of a people with knowledge activates khayr as selection rather than raw advantage, while the following manifest trial makes selection a condition-exposing responsibility. The focus question probes a claim to election without granting election as immunity.

activation_trace.role: Chosen excellence supplies the focus comparison's possible status claim.
Choosing between alternatives makes 'better' answerable as election.
Explicit choosing with knowledge directly activates the election branch of focus khayr.
Testing that makes a condition appear turns chosen status into exposure.
The second mapped trial inventory independently reinforces examination as revelation of state.

structural_cues: 44:32 names knowledgeable choosing of a people immediately before the denial and comparison sequence.
44:33 places manifest trial inside the signs given to that chosen people.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies explicit choosing and a neighboring trial that reveals condition; I infer that their proximity qualifies election as tested responsibility. A live alternative is that the choice denotes historical favor while the trial is an unrelated gift or ordeal.

changed_reading.before: أَهُمْ خَيْرٌ asks whether the addressees are stronger, richer, or generally superior.
changed_reading.after: It also audits a claim to chosen excellence, while the context denies that being chosen can bypass the trial that reveals criminal response.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate denial of purposeless play and assertion of creation in truth supply a normative field for j-r-m's earning branch. The destroyed people did not merely lose a power contest; their mode of action incurred an outcome within a reality ordered toward valid purpose and obligation.

activation_trace.role: Beneficial good supplies a purposive standard for the comparison.
Earning and incurring make consequence answer conduct rather than comparative force.
Action without a sound aim supplies the expressly rejected model of reality.
Stable correspondence to reality supplies the positive alternative to play.
Fixed obligation and deserved claim give incurred consequence a normative direction.

structural_cues: 44:38-39 immediately follows the focus by denying play and affirming creation in truth.
The focus's causal إِنَّهُمْ clause is therefore bracketed by a question of worth and a declaration of purpose.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies purposeless play, truth, obligation, and moral earning; I infer that conduct misaligned with created purpose incurs the focus destruction. A live alternative is that 44:38-39 only answers resurrection denial and does not explain the historical causal clause.

changed_reading.before: The comparison decides which people possessed greater worldly power.
changed_reading.after: The comparison tests fit with a purposeful moral order, and destruction appears as incurred liability rather than proof that one worldly force beat another.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus qawm can carry the image of a collective mainstay, but the appointed day strips every patron relation of sufficiency and aid. The comparison is thus a stress test of corporate support, not an invitation to identify the larger coalition.

activation_trace.role: A human collective supplies the social body whose efficacy is questioned.
Support, mainstay, and subsistence expose the function expected from that social body.
Affection, alliance, and aid identify the close relation explicitly denied effective force.
Sufficiency names the function one patron cannot provide another.
Aid and making prevail supply the rescue function expressly withheld.

structural_cues: 44:40 gathers all at a day of separation.
44:41 repeats patron against patron and denies both benefit and rescue.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies qawm as mainstay and then negates patronal sufficiency and aid; I infer that collective support is one hidden basis of the 'better' claim being dismantled. A live alternative is that patron failure concerns only individuals at judgment and does not reactivate qawm in the focus.

changed_reading.before: The verse compares the strength of one nation with another.
changed_reading.after: It asks whether belonging to any apparently sustaining collective can confer immunity when the very functions of patronage, sufficiency, and rescue are suspended.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same q-w-m inventory moves from qawm in the focus to an honored station that is abandoned and a secure station that endures. Worth migrates from corporate status to the quality of one's standing: honor alone does not secure a station, while safety marks the alternative outcome.

activation_trace.role: Station and residence place a latent standing-image beneath the focus's qawm.
An explicit station supplies a prestigious but abandoned form of standing.
Honored nobility marks that first station as high-status without making it durable.
The later station supplies a second form of standing for direct contrast.
Settled security distinguishes enduring standing from merely honored occupancy.

structural_cues: 44:26 names an honored station among possessions that are left behind.
44:51 names a secure station after judgment and rescue have been differentiated.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two maqam phrases from the focus qawm root, one honored and abandoned and one secure; I infer that the focus comparison relocates worth from group identity to durable standing. A live alternative is that the shared root is only derivational recurrence without a designed contrast.

changed_reading.before: قَوْمُ names only a population whose status is compared with another population.
changed_reading.after: The population's standing is itself on trial: prestigious occupancy can be lost, while secure standing, not corporate name, is the meaningful good.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it overlays the spatial facing branch on a grammatically temporal قَبْلِهِم. It remains anchored in that exact root, the focus's comparative syntax, the later gathering, and the explicit same-root mutual facing; downstream prose should present it as a spatial echo that changes the scene, not as a replacement translation of 'before.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The comparison with وَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِم can stage predecessors as more than objects receding behind the addressees.

activation_trace.role: Priorness preserves the controlling temporal sense of the focus construction.
Facing one thing toward another supplies the latent spatial overlay on the comparison.
Regathering the dispersed supplies a scene in which separated generations can confront one another.
Explicit mutual facing activates the same root's spatial branch after the focus.

changed_reading.before: Earlier peoples remain safely behind the addressees as dead historical data.
changed_reading.after: The rhetorical comparison turns those behind in time into a confronting presence, and later gathering keeps open an eventual face-to-face tableau.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because value and pricing belong to q-w-m's wider inventory while the surface qawm plainly denotes a people. It remains worth carrying because the focus explicitly asks who is better and the later coercive tasting ironizes titles of might and honor; downstream prose should call it an appraisal metaphor, not derive 'people' from 'price.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: أَهُمْ خَيْرٌ frames the qawm comparison as an evaluation whose hidden criteria can be exposed.

activation_trace.role: Chosen excellence supplies the positive appraisal claimed by the compared group.
Value and appraisal turn the qawm into the object of a deliberately contained valuation metaphor.
Experiential tasting converts verbal self-appraisal into an embodied audit.
Might after lowliness supplies one of the self-valuing titles exposed by the audit.
Nobility and praised generosity supply the second status title placed under irony.

changed_reading.before: The focus externally ranks one civilization against another.
changed_reading.after: It opens an appraisal of the addressees' own titles and self-price, which the later command to taste subjects to an embodied, ironic valuation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is the strangest activation because it uses kh-y-r's idiom of coaxing an animal from a burrow as a functional analogy for rhetoric. It remains anchored in the focus's interrogative khayr, the later facilitated language, message-bearing tongue, and reciprocal waiting; downstream prose should describe the question as behaving like a coaxing device, never lexicalize خَيْرٌ as an animal image.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The interrogative أَهُمْ خَيْرٌ can operate as an action upon the audience as well as carry propositional content.

activation_trace.role: Coaxing an animal from concealment supplies the contained image of forcing a hidden claim into view.
Choosing between alternatives supplies the literal interrogative fork through which the coaxing works.
Opening and ease after difficulty present the discourse as made accessible for response.
A tongue delivering a message supplies the rhetorical channel that carries the extracting question.
Reciprocal watching and waiting hold open the interval in which the exposed claim receives its outcome.

changed_reading.before: The rhetorical question merely asserts that the addressees are no stronger than destroyed peoples.
changed_reading.after: The question also functions as a pressure device: its forced choice coaxes concealed exceptionalism into the open, after which both sides wait for the claim's verification.

strongest_changes: The direct خ ي ر echo in 44:32 changes 'better' from raw advantage into election under a revealing trial.
The Pharaoh sequence makes the focus comparison a repeated assay, not a static catalogue of dead powers.
Abandonment and inheritance turn destruction into removal of occupants from a transferable historical standing.
Separation, resurrection, appointment, and gathering make historical extinction a provisional cutoff before adjudication.
The j-r-m harvest branches remain live through crops, tree, food, and tasting as an exploratory consequence circuit.
summary.what_was_special: Same-root echoes redistribute the focus terms across choosing, trial, station, gathering, valuation, and facing, while the j-r-m branch network adds a material harvest-to-taste causality. These mechanisms let election, succession, liability, social support, and confrontation coexist without selecting one final reading.
remaining_uncertainties: The qawm-to-maqam standing model may be a designed root echo or only derivational recurrence.
The harvest-to-taste circuit is visibly anchored but depends on a cross-episode material analogy.
The face-to-face and appraisal outliers should remain overlays because the focus surfaces retain their ordinary temporal and collective senses.
Treating destruction as provisional depends on sequencing the separation and regathering cues rather than reading them as independent motifs.
